items.description: Welcoming contributions!
items.title: Newsletters

items.description: Podcasts and podcast episodes, that either directly focus on vehicle security or have some episodes on it.
items.title: Podcasts and Episodes

items.description: Software applications that will help you hack your car, investigate it's signals, and general tinkering with it.

items.title: openpilot
items.description: openpilot is an open source driving agent that performs the functions of Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) for Hondas and Acuras.

items.title: openalpr
items.description: An open source Automatic License Plate Recognition library written in C++ with bindings in C#, Java, Node.js, Go, and Python.

items.title: Tesla Mod
items.description: Tesla CAN bus toolkit for Flipper Zero and ESP32. Nag killer, FSD region unlock, track mode, BMS dashboard, blind spot alert, high beam strobe, and 30+ more CAN handlers. Open source (GPL-3.0).

items.title: CANalyzat0r
items.description: A security analysis toolkit for proprietary car protocols.

items.title: UDSim
items.description: GUI tool that can monitor a CAN bus and automatically learn the devices attached to it by watching communications.

items.title: CANToolz
items.description: CANToolz is a framework for analysing CAN networks and devices. It is based on several modules which can be assembled in a pipeline.

items.title: mazda_getInfo
items.description: A PoC that the USB port is an attack surface for a Mazda car's infotainment system and how Mazda hacks are made (known bug in the CMU).

items.title: talking-with-cars
items.description: CAN related scripts, and scripts to use a car as a gamepad

items.title: BlackFlag ECU
items.description: Professional ECU diagnostics and tuning suite with OBD-II scanning, DTC reading, live sensor monitoring, and reflash capabilities.

items.title: Applications

items.description:
Libraries and tools that don't fall under the larger class of applications above.
Custom Applications SDK for Mazda Connect Infotainment System - A micro framework that allows you to write and deploy custom applications for the Mazda Infotainment System.
items.title: Libraries and Tools
SocketCAN Utils
items.description: Userspace utilites for SocketCAN on Linux.

items.title: dbcc
items.description: "dbcc is a program for converting a DBC file primarily into into C code that can serialize and deserialize CAN messages." With existing DBC files from a vehicle, this file allows you to convert them to C code that extracts the CAN messages and properties of the CAN environment.

items.title: vircar
items.description: a Virtual car userspace that sends CAN messages based on SocketCAN

items.title: CANdevStudio
items.description: Development tool for CAN bus simulation. CANdevStudio enables to simulate CAN signals such as ignition status, doors status or reverse gear by every automotive developer.

items.title: UnlockECU
items.description: Free, open-source ECU seed-key unlocking tool.

items.title: CanCat
items.description: A "swiss-army knife" for interacting with live CAN data. Primary API interface in Python, but written in C++.

items.title: High Level ViWi Service
items.description: High level Volkswagen CAN signaling protocol implementation.

items.title: Scapy
items.description: A python library to send, receive, edit raw packets. Supports CAN and automotive protocols: see the automotive doc

items.title: cantools
items.description: Python module to decode and encode CAN messages using a DBC file

items.title: Python-CAN
items.description: Python interface to various CAN implementations, including SocketCAN. Allows you to use Python 2.7.x or 3.3.x+ to communicate over CAN networks.

items.title: Python-OBD
items.description: A Python module for handling realtime sensor data from OBD-II vehicle ports. Works with ELM327 OBD-II adapters, and is fit for the Raspberry Pi.

items.title: canmatrix
items.description: Python module to work with CAN matrix files

items.title: Caring Caribou
items.description: Intended to be the nmap of vehicle security.

items.title: CANard
items.description: A Python framework for Controller Area Network applications.

items.title: CanoPy
items.description: A python gui used to visualize and plot message payloads in real time.

items.title: CanCat
items.description: A "swiss-army knife" for interacting with live CAN data. Primary API interface in Python, but written in C++.

items.title: Jumpstarter
items.description: A hardware-in-the-loop testing framework with automotive diagnostic drivers for UDS, DoIP, and CAN bus protocols.

items.title: canTot
items.description: A python-based cli framework based on sploitkit and is easy to use because it similar to working with Metasploit. This similar to an exploit framework but focused on known CAN Bus vulnerabilities or fun CAN Bus hacks.

items.title: c0f
items.description: A fingerprinting tool for CAN communications that can be used to find a specific signal on a CAN network when testing interactions with a vehicle.

items.title: Caring Caribou Next
items.description: Upgraded and optimized version of the original Caring Caribou project.

items.title: canarchy
items.description: CANarchy is a stream-first CAN analysis and manipulation runtime designed for automation, security research, and agent-driven workflows.

items.title: CANNiBUS
items.description: A Go server that allows a room full of researchers to simultaneously work on the same vehicle, whether for instructional purposes or team reversing sessions.

items.title: CAN Simulator
items.description: A Go based CAN simulator for the Raspberry Pi to be used with PiCAN2 or the open source CAN Simulator board
